To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have demonstrated a passively Q- switched Nd:Sr/sub5/(VO/sub4/)/sub3/F laser in a laser-diode-pumped configuration.
we have demonstrated a new laser system that can generate stable laser pulses as short at 4.3ns.
a passively Qswitched Nd:Sr/sub5/(VO/sub4/)/sub3/F laser can be realized with a high-brightness laser diode as a pump source and a Cr/sup3+/:YALG crystal as a saturable absorber.
In summary, our research is concerned with
high-brightness laser diode pumped passively q-switched Nd:Sr/sub5/(VO/sub4/)/sub3/F lasers.
the passively Q-switching of a diode-end-pumped Nd:Sr/sub x/(VO/sub 3/)/sub y/F laser with Cr/sup 4+:YAG as the saturable-absorbing material.
the development and characterization of high-power, high-brightness and high-temperature-resistant laser diodes for pumping solid-state lasers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the laser-diode pumped Nd:S-VAP laser has been successfully demonstrated.

this work has shown the possibility of using a high-brightness laser diode to pump passively Q-switch Nd:Sr/sub5/(VO/sub4/)/sub3/F lasers, which has the potential for a wide variety of practical applications.

the present study has demonstrated the feasibility of using a Cr/sup3+/:YAG crystal as a saturable absorber in passively Q-switching Nd:Sr/sub5/(VO/sub4/)/sub3/F lasers pumped by a l-W high brightness laser diode, which has a high efficiency, good long-term stability and a simple configuration.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a 1-W, high-brightness, 1.06-m laser-diode can pump a 2-mm Nd:Sr/sub x/VO/sub 4/F crystal, and a 4.3-ns laser pulse with a maximum energy of 1 mJ can be generated.
a 1.06-mu m laser with high efficiency and good stability can be achieved by the combination of a high-brightness laser diode with a Cr/sup3+:YAG saturable absorber.
the passively Q-switching operation of a Nd/Sr/sub 5/ (VO/sub 4)/sub 3/ laser with a Cr/sup +3/:YAG saturable absorber can be achieved by using a 1-W laser diode as the pump source.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Nd/Sr/sub 5/ (VO/sub 4//sub 3/F crystal is a promising candidate for the generation of high-power laser pulses with high repetition rates.
the laser-diode pumping is a promising approach to achieve a high-brightness Q-switched laser.
the use of a high-brightness laser diode as the pump source can greatly simplify the laser system and make it compact and stable.
